shortDescription: Manipulate SNMP trap information on a BIG-IP

options.name: auth_password
options.description: Specifies the Authentication protocol password to be used for snmp v3 traps Required for the C(snmp_version) matches C(v3) and for the C(security_level)

options.name: auth_protocol
options.description: Specifies the Authentication protocol to be used for snmp v3 traps Required for the C(security_level)

options.name: community
options.description: Specifies the community name for the trap destination.

options.name: destination
options.description: Specifies the address for the trap destination. This can be either an IP address or a hostname.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the SNMP configuration endpoint.

options.name: network
options.description: Specifies the name of the trap network. This option is not supported in versions of BIG-IP prior to 12.1.0, and is simply ignored on those versions. The value C(default) was removed in BIG-IP version 13.1.0. Specifying this value when configuring a BIG-IP causes the module to stop and report an error. In this case, choose one of the other options, such as C(management).

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to manage resources on.

options.name: port
options.description: Specifies the port for the trap destination.

options.name: privacy_password
options.description: Specifies the Privacy protocol password to be used for snmp v3 traps Required for the C(security_level) matches c(auth-privacy)

options.name: privacy_protocol
options.description: Specifies the Privacy protocol to be used for snmp v3 traps Required for the C(security_level) matches c(auth-privacy)

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: security_level
options.description: Specifies the port for the trap destination. Required for the C(snmp_version) matches C(v3).

options.name: security_name
options.description: Specifies the security name to used for v3 snmp trap Required for the C(snmp_version) matches C(v3).

options.name: snmp_version
options.description: Specifies to which Simple Network Management Protocol (SNMP) version the trap destination applies.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the resource exists. When C(absent), ensures the resource does not exist.
